title: A business importer re-seed writes only the preference keys it changes

source.ref: Space function scan 2026-11-18, the residual LIVE-2347 named (lib/importer/materialize.ts)

detail: The business importer (lib/importer/materialize.ts writeProfileDataAndLayout) read spaces.preferences, built the next object (profileData, profileLayout, theme, pageDocs.home, the importerEditWins marker) and wrote the whole blob back through the admin client. A seed or re-seed landing beside a save from another console (a Spotlight publish, a menu save, a website editor stub) could undo it. Fixed: the next object is diffed against the snapshot (lib/spaces/preferences-patch.ts preferencesPatch) and only the top-level keys that changed go through patchSpacePreferences (set_space_preferences, SCAN-833) in one call, a removed key (theme back to the default) as null. The importer runs without a signed-in owner, but set_space_preferences is granted to service_role only and patchSpacePreferences calls it through the admin client, so this background path is exactly its intended caller: no migration, no auth change. An unchanged re-seed sends nothing. A refused or failed patch now reports profileData and siteDoc as not written (the old update ignored a returned error). websiteEditor and programOverview are never sent. Residual: the RPC merges top-level keys only, so a concurrent save to the SAME key (pageDocs) can still overwrite inside that key.

verify.note: Fails while lib/importer/materialize.ts writes the whole preferences blob or writeProfileDataAndLayout does not send a key-scoped patch. Behavior test: lib/importer/materialize.test.ts (preferences are a key-scoped patch).
